eventUi.noImageHelp: An event photo or poster helps the public form look professional and recognizable.
eventUi.imageHelp: PNG, JPG, or WEBP images up to 4 MB are accepted. Ideally upload a 500×500 px square photo (1:1 ratio); other sizes are adjusted automatically without cropping, adding white margins when needed.
eventUi.guideHelp: Upload a PDF or Word file with race instructions for registrants to download.
eventUi.qrHelp: Without a QR code, athletes know how much to pay but not where. Upload the payment account QR image.
eventUi.qrDescription: This is the QR code each registrant sees with the amount they must pay.
eventUi.qrAdvice: It should point to the account receiving the collection and be readable from a phone.
eventUi.fileFormat: The format is verified by reading the file, not by its extension.
eventUi.noCategoriesHelp: Without categories, registrants remain unclassified and the award report is not useful.
eventUi.distanceHelp: Stored as whole meters: 10000 for 10K, 30000 for 30K.
eventUi.finalPrice: Final price paid by the athlete
eventUi.qrPerCellHelp: Each final price has its own payment QR: Bolivian bank QR codes carry the amount, so one QR cannot cover two different prices.
eventUi.qrAmountTooltip: This QR must be generated for exactly {{monto}}: it's the final price for this price tier and kit (tier price + kit surcharge + the service fee from Settings). If the QR carries a different amount, the payment won't match what the system expects.
